title: Design patterns you actually use: strategy, factory, observer, repository

preview.what: The handful of design patterns that show up in real Laravel work.
preview.picture: Strategy = choosing bKash/Stripe/Nagad behind one interface; Factory = a kitchen that assembles the right object; Observer = 'text me when the order ships'; Repository = the librarian between you and the shelves.
preview.why: Interviewers ask for a pattern you used and a time one was overkill.
preview.bn: Strategy (bKash/Stripe এক interface-এর পিছনে), Factory, Observer, Repository — যেগুলো সত্যি লাগে।
